text:
Maria V: Quick heads up — I put together the social slate for next week's benchmark release and webinar. Need final copy + hero assets for X and LinkedIn. Also want to A/B CTA text. Who can own image edits and alt text? :calendar:

Ajay K: I can do image edits and export sizes. Drop originals in the drive and I'll send web- and x-ready files by EOD tomorrow.

Maria V: Thanks Ajay. Drive folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/example-benchmark-assets — the hero PSD + screenshots are in /raw.

Sam T: For CTAs, recommend we test 2 variants across channels: 
```
Variant A: "See benchmark results →"
Variant B: "Register for the webinar →"
```
Let's run A on X and B on LinkedIn and compare CTRs.

Jordan P: I can run the X A/B test. Suggest scheduling posts at 10:00am and 3:00pm PST (10am for organic reach, 3pm for follow-up). For LinkedIn, use 11am. Will set up UTM tags.

Emily R: I'll craft short copy and 2 long-form LinkedIn versions. Drafts below — pick tone and I'll iterate: 

Copy-short-X: "New benchmark — 3x faster inference and half the cost. See how we measured it. → https://redwood.ai/benchmark?utm_source=x"
Copy-long-linkedin: "We ran production workloads across 3 model families and measured throughput, latency, and cost. Join our webinar to see the methodology and get the rollout checklist. Register: https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=linkedin"

Maria V: Nice. Add a line about dedicated & private options for the enterprise audience on the LinkedIn long copy.

Emily R: Done. Also adding an optional testimonial quote block for LinkedIn long.

Ajay K: Uploaded optimized hero images: hero_1200x630.png, hero_1024x512.png + alt text file hero_alt.txt in the same drive folder. Ping me for any crop tweaks.

Jordan P: Scheduling notes: will create two X threads — one initial post + follow-up thread with a 5-tweet breakdown (key results, methodology, invite). Want to confirm the order of the follow-up bullets.

Sam T: Suggested thread order: 1) headline stat, 2) why it matters (cost/latency), 3) short methodology blurb, 4) join webinar CTA + reg link, 5) screenshot of graphs.

Emily R: I'll prepare the 5 tweets copy and the LinkedIn carousel copy. Also can supply alt text for each slide.

SocialBot: :spiral_calendar: Reminder: Webinar slot added to Marketing calendar on 2026-04-02 11:00 PDT. Registration page live: https://redwood.ai/webinar

Maria V: Can someone make a 30s highlight clip from the demo for a pinned X video? That would boost CTR on the initial post.

Ajay K: Yep — can make a 30s clip. Need a timecode for the demo segment and any branding overlays.

Emily R: I'll mark the exact 0:48–1:18 clip in the raw video and add suggested overlay text.

Jordan P: For reporting, let's track: impressions, link clicks, CTR, registration conversions, and webinar signups per channel. I'll create a simple sheet and share.

Sam T: Also add engagement follow-up play: 24h after main post, reply to top comments with a thread pointing to slides + registration. That helps capture late traffic.

Maria V: Great — owners: Ajay (images + clip), Emily (copy + alt text), Jordan (scheduling + UTM + reporting), Sam (A/B plan + follow-ups). I'll queue everything in the scheduler once assets and copy are final. Target: final review by 2026-03-28 EOD. :white_check_mark:

Emily R: Got it — planning a quick review meeting Thu AM if needed.

Ajay K: Files done. Tag me in the scheduler when ready to publish.

Jordan P: Scheduling draft set, will not publish until we get the final sign-off.

Maria V: Thanks team — will consolidate comments and move to final. :sparkles:
